title: Verify checklist step saves successfully with valid data
description: Ensures the save endpoint returns success when all required fields are provided.
preconditions: User is logged in with QA role
User is on the Checklist Step page

manual_steps.action: Fill all required fields and click Save
manual_steps.expected_result: Form saves successfully. Success message is shown.

manual_steps.action: Refresh the page and verify data persists
manual_steps.expected_result: Saved data is still visible with correct values.
